Hi Irene,

Thanks for walking through the CVE list on Friday. For HelioPay's internal audit we need a concise closure acceptance and a simple patch manifest that shows the following for each CVE: CVE id, affected component, PR/patch reference, date applied, owner, and whether the fix was deployed to production.

Can you provide:
- A signed acceptance note that the items listed in the April/Nov scan have been remediated or scheduled under an SLA exception.
- A single CSV manifest that HelioPay's auditor can ingest (columns as above).
- Export of the vulnerability scan summary that shows the scan date and baseline used.

We're aiming to close this on our side by EOD 12 Nov to keep the audit timeline. If you expect any CVEs to remain open beyond that date, please include a short remediation timeline per CVE and the SLA bucket (e.g., Critical - 7 days, High - 30 days).

Attachments we referenced: the HelioPay SIG spreadsheet (we will attach on our side).

Thanks,
Donna Liao
Security Program Manager
HelioPay
